1. Recruitment Overview
The CivicGrid Recruitment Council (CGRC) invites online applications from eligible candidates for recruitment to

the post of Digital Administration Assistant (DAA) in participating central government offices.
The recruitment is intended to identify candidates with general administrative, digital documentation,
communication, and basic computer skills.
The recruitment process consists of:
1. Computer-Based Examination (CBE)
2. Skill Assessment
3. Document Verification
4. Final selection and appointment formalities
Candidates should read this notification carefully before submitting an application. Submission of an application
does not by itself establish eligibility for appointment.

19. Marking Scheme
Each correct answer carries 2 marks.
For every incorrect answer:
0.50 marks will be deducted.
There is no negative marking for an unanswered question.
Example
If a candidate answers:
 70 questions correctly
 20 questions incorrectly
 10 questions unanswered
The score before any normalization would be:
70 × 2 − 20 × 0.50 = 130 marks
---
20. Normalization

The score before any normalization would be:

20. Normalization
If the Computer-Based Examination is conducted in multiple shifts, the Board may apply a statistical normalization
procedure to account for differences in question difficulty between shifts.
The normalized score may be used for shortlisting candidates.
The exact normalization procedure, if applied, will be communicated through the recruitment instructions.
Candidates should not assume that the raw score alone will determine the final ranking when multiple-shift
normalization is used.
